resources.string: The service did not start the recorder helper. Restart it and reconnect. If this repeats, see Setup help and copy the diagnostic report.
The service did not return a recorder connection. Restart it and reconnect. Some phone software has a service startup issue. Setup help explains what to check.
The service runs, but recording will not connect

Restart your service app, return here and reconnect. Then run the Connection test. If the recorder still will not start, copy the Diagnostics report and include your phone model, Android version and service app version when reporting it. Some manufacturer builds can stop Shizuku 13.6.0 from starting its helper before ClipHistory runs. A timeout alone does not identify the cause. Check the official compatibility report for updates. Clearing saved history or granting unrelated permissions does not repair this startup problem.
